**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/12/10 (Sun) 20:58
- [EVENT] User is thinking of recording a walkthrough for Resident Evil Village.
- [PREFERENCE] User wants to focus on the game's story and characters in their walkthrough.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended software options for screen recording and video editing, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] OBS Studio (Free, Open-source): Highly customizable, widely used by streamers and YouTubers.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] XSplit (Free Trial, Paid): User-friendly interface, good for beginners.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Game Bar (Free, Windows 10 only): Built-in feature with basic editing.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] ShadowPlay (Free, NVIDIA GeForce only): Great for NVIDIA users, records gameplay.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended video editing software options, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Adobe Premiere Pro (Paid, Subscription-based): Professional-level with advanced features.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] DaVinci Resolve (Free, Paid upgrade): Popular with a free version for beginners.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] CyberLink PowerDirector (Paid, One-time purchase): User-friendly with various effects.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shotcut (Free, Open-source): Advanced features but steeper learning curve.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tips for recording, including:
  - Ensure computer meets system requirements.
  - Invest in a good quality microphone and webcam.
  - Plan the walkthrough, including scriptwriting.
  - Export in a compatible format for the desired platform.
- [EVENT] User has heard of OBS Studio and Adobe Premiere Pro but has never used them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a comparison of OBS Studio and XSplit, highlighting:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] OBS Studio: Free, highly customizable, low system requirements, but has a steeper learning curve.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] XSplit: User-friendly, easy scene setup, but requires more resources and has a free trial with a paid version for advanced features.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both OBS and XSplit can record screen, webcam, and microphone simultaneously, with high-quality video and audio recording.
- [EVENT] User decided to try out OBS Studio first since it's free and has more customization options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided resources for tutorials and guides for setting up OBS Studio, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Official OBS Studio Documentation and YouTube Channel.
